criteria.title: Customer-specific factual fidelity
criteria.description: The sendable email accurately conveys the target customer, operational impact, affected behavior, validated workaround, unaffected functions, missed update, incident ownership, and next-update checkpoint found in the frozen records.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Authorized commitments and confidentiality boundaries
criteria.description: The customer-facing portion withholds confidential internal details, does not invent a fix time, credit, or roadmap commitment, treats the credit and automatic-retry requests accurately, and distinguishes the next communication update from a resolution ETA.

anchors.0: The named delivery condition is absent, incorrect, or unusable.
anchors.10: Every substantive clause of the named delivery condition is met by concrete evidence.

completion_gate.rationale: Every task-specific delivery condition is required. No weighted quality points or partial credit are awarded.
